THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 01 / OCTOBER 2026
TEXTURE IN MOTION
055
77
Noir Tweed
Schoolbook Noir
A full-length studio look in an
oversized black tweed jacket with a
white collar, pearl buttons and
wide patch pockets, over black
shorts and tall black buckled boots.
An open old book rests on the floor
beside her, casting a long shadow
on a white wall.
